about: Shared Ruby/JS vectors for FundTogether's Safe layer. Amounts and nonces are decimal strings; hex is lowercase and 0x-prefixed. Real rows were read from public chains on 2026-11-09 and recomputed; rows marked synthetic are computed locally. Test keys are the publicly known private keys 1..4: never fund them. Policy checks run in this order and the first failure is the code: operation, safe_tx_gas, base_gas, gas_price, gas_token, refund_receiver, nonce, target rules.
